Subject: Demo request — Redwood demo request

Hi Marissa,

I signed up on the Redwood site this morning and requested a demo for our team at CareTech. Quick context: we are building a support/knowledge search experience for our clinicians and want to evaluate embeddings + reranking for 1) semantic search over internal docs and 2) question answering.

Estimated traffic: ~200M queries/month across autoscaling workloads. Latency SLO: sub-200ms for tail requests (ideally). Timeline: hoping to start a paid pilot in Q2 (April).

Can we schedule a 30-minute demo next week to walk through the product, expected throughput/cost, and security/compliance posture? Also happy to answer any prep questions.

Thanks,
Sam Patel
Head of Data Platform
CareTech, Inc.

Hi Sam — great to meet you (virtually) and thanks for the details. I support inbound demos and would love to get a bit more context so we tailor the session for your pilot. A few quick questions:

- Primary use case: is the focus mostly semantic search over documents, or are you planning to use embeddings for reranking and QA as well?
- Data sensitivity: will queries or documents include PHI/PII? (helps with deployment/recommendation)
- Traffic profile: the 200M/month estimate — is that steady-state or peak after launch? Any per-minute TPS estimate?
- Users & roles: who would attend from CareTech (engineering, product, security)?
- Timeline & procurement: April pilot — is there a procurement/budget gate we should know about?

Availability: I can do 30 minutes on the following slots (PST):
- Tue 2026-03-31 09:00–09:30 or 11:00–11:30
- Wed 2026-04-01 10:00–10:30 or 15:00–15:30

If none of those work, send a few times that do and I’ll adjust. I’ll also loop in our AE who can discuss cost/commitment if the pilot looks like a fit.

Best,
Marissa Cole
Account Development Representative | Redwood Inference
marissa_cole@redwood.ai

Hi Marissa — thanks for the quick follow-up. Answers below: 

- Primary use case: both — semantic search is the main priority (doc search + clinical notes), but we also want embeddings + reranking for the patient Q&A assistant.
- Data sensitivity: yes, some records contain PHI. We will need to explore Private deployment options or strict VPC/KMS controls.
- Traffic profile: 200M/month is projected steady-state after rollout; peak TPS during clinic hours could approach 400–500 reqs/sec.
- Attendees: Myself (Head of Data Platform), Lina Gomez (lead ML engineer), and our security lead (TBD).
- Procurement: budget approved for a pilot in April; procurement is fairly quick but needs SOC2 evidence and an MSA with standard security addenda.

Preferred slot: Wed 2026-04-01 10:00–10:30 PST works best for us.

Also attached our preliminary security questionnaire (redacted).
